key.name: toggle-popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Panora clipboard history popup.

key.name: move-to-pointer
key.summary: Open the popup next to the pointer
key.description: Move the Panora window to the mouse pointer once it appears, like the Windows clipboard flyout.

key.name: restore-message-tray
key.description: The original value of org.gnome.shell.keybindings toggle-message-tray, saved when the extension removed a shortcut that collided with toggle-popup (GNOME binds Super+V to the notification list by default). Restored when the extension is disabled. Empty when nothing was changed.
